description: This file contains a test for POSIX socket receive functionality, including a transfer function and a test case 'PosixSocketReceiveTest.SunnyDay' that sets up sockets, transfers data, and verifies correctness.

methods.name: Transfer
methods.description: Transfers data between two connected sockets until the specified size is transferred or an error occurs.

methods.name: PosixSocketReceiveTest.SunnyDay
methods.description: Test case that sets up sockets, transfers data in both directions, and verifies data integrity.
